title: Swamideen v. State of U.P. and 5 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Petition disposed; clause 6.5 objection; coercive recovery stayed six weeks
headnote: Writ challenging recovery certificates for electricity dues of Rs. 1,92,974 disposed of with liberty to file an objection under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, to be decided by respondent no. 3 by a speaking order; coercive recovery stayed for six weeks.
facts: Swamideen filed Writ-C No. 9710 of 2023 in the Allahabad High Court against the State of U.P. and five others. He challenged recovery certificates of 7 September 2021 and 13 January 2022, issued by respondent nos. 3 and 5, for electricity dues of Rs. 1,92,974. On 27 March 2023 the Electricity Department sought time for instructions, and coercive action on the certificates was restrained until the next date. On 3 April 2023 the Department said any objection he filed would be decided under clause 6.5 of the Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: objection to recovery of electricity dues
holding_units.holding: The writ against recovery certificates for electricity dues is disposed of with liberty to the consumer to file an objection within three weeks. Respondent no. 3 shall decide that objection by a speaking order within the next three weeks, in terms of clause 6.5. Coercive measures on the recovery shall not be taken for six weeks and shall thereafter abide by that decision.

principle_tags.application: The writ was disposed without examining the demand, with liberty to object under clause 6.5 and a direction that respondent no. 3 pass a speaking order.
Coercive action on the recovery certificates was restrained for six weeks, covering the time to file and decide the clause 6.5 objection.

not_decided.point: Whether the electricity dues of Rs. 1,92,974 and the recovery certificates dated 7.9.2021 and 13.1.2022 were justified
not_decided.note: Left to respondent no. 3 on an objection under clause 6.5, to be decided by a speaking order.
